blocks.p: Each car's radio opens up close, above the dashboard. There it can be tuned, your stations stored and a CD played. Figure 35-1, on the facing page, shows the Premium Technologies CD receiver.
The display shows the band, the frequency, the name of the station and the signal. The controls are set out in Table 35-1.

table.label: Table 35-1
table.title: The controls of the CD receiver
head: Control
What it does
rows: Turn it to set the volume. Push it to turn the radio on or off.
Turn it to tune the frequency.
Press a preset to listen to its station. Hold one to store the station tuned.
Steps through the stations until it is pressed again.
Gives the CD back. It is above *MUTE*.

blocks.note: A car fitted with the plain ValuTech FM set shows that set instead. It has no CD player.

caption: Figure 35-1
The Premium Technologies CD receiver, up close, with the radio on.

blocks.p: To store a station, tune it with the right knob and hold a preset. Press the preset to listen to it again.

marks.text: The left knob sets the volume. Push it to turn the radio on or off.
The display shows the band, the frequency, the station's name and the signal.
The right knob tunes the frequency.
The play button starts and stops a CD. The eject button above MUTE gives it back.
Press a preset to listen. Hold one to store the tuned station.
SCAN steps through the stations until pressed again. SEEK goes to the next one. MUTE cuts the sound.

sticky.text: Tune it, store your stations, play a CD.
